trials.name: 1-minute liquidation-cascade fade
trials.reason: Gross edge approximately zero; the fade loses the 16 bps round trip. No reversion after 3-sigma 1-minute moves.

trials.name: Cross-sectional funding-extreme reversal, daily rebalance
trials.reason: Real gross signal, but 105% daily turnover costs ~30% annualized. Net Sharpe and -48% drawdown fail the gates. 2021-dependent, 2024 negative.

trials.name: Funding-extreme reversal, lower-turnover holding periods
trials.reason: The funding reversal decays within a day. Holding longer cuts costs but loses more signal than it saves. Daily remains the best version and still fails.

trials.name: Volatility-compression range breakout
trials.reason: Fake edge. The entire return is captured by filling at the signal bar's close. A one-hour delay turns Sharpe -0.73; a one-minute delay turns it -1.08. Not deployable.

trials.name: Cross-sectional beta overshoot after BTC shocks, 5m
trials.reason: Gross residual reversal is +1.5 bps per event, far below the 16 bps round trip. Ranking on beta residuals adds nothing over ranking on raw returns. Signal exists but is not monetizable at this horizon/cost.

trials.name: Cross-sectional momentum, weekly rebalance, long winners / short losers
trials.reason: Best discovery result in the lab (0.81 net Sharpe, p=0.005 placebo) but the edge dies out of sample: holdout Sharpe -0.43, 2026 -1.11. Classic regime dependence on the 2021/2023 alt seasons. The first implementation had a sign bug and tested the reversal book; the corrected book is the number reported here.

trials.name: Funding-crowding reversal including funding cash flow
trials.reason: Adding the funding cash flow lifts net Sharpe from 0.49 to 0.70 but cannot fix the economics. The signal is positive in 2020-2021, flat in 2022-2023 and negative in 2024, so it fails the sub-period gate even before the drawdown gate.

trials.name: 12-month time-series momentum, monthly rebalance, vol-scaled
trials.reason: Costs are negligible at a monthly cadence, so the failure is the signal: gross Sharpe 0.36 and a -72% drawdown. Trend did not pay on this basket in 2023-2024 and the placebo is not significant.

trials.name: Weekend alt-bleed relative value (long BTC / short alt basket, Fri 00:00 -> Mon 00:00)
trials.reason: The pre-registered direction was backwards: alts outperform BTC over the weekend, not the other way round. The mirror trade is real in 2020-2024 (t=4.0) but the gross edge is only ~31-39 bps/week against 16 bps of weekly cost, and it disappears in the 2025-2026 holdout (gross -8 to +1 bps/week). Dead on both counts.

trials.name: Open-interest crowding pilot (live 21-day sample)
trials.reason: Fading a crowded OI+price move has a +12.4 bps gross edge per 8h event (t=1.70) but the 16 bps round trip eats it. The sample is 21 days of one regime, so this is a mechanism check, not evidence. Binance only serves ~21 days of OI history; a forward recorder is required before this can be tested properly.

cost_model.note: 8 bps/side = Binance taker 4.5 bps + 3.5 bps slippage. Every trial reports the primary cost; low-turnover ideas are additionally checked at 4 bps. No candidate became viable at 4 bps either.

key_lessons: Same-bar fills create fake edges: H3 looked like Sharpe 4.7 until a one-minute entry delay turned it negative.
The only strong gross signals (funding crowding 1.54, cross-sectional momentum 0.91) are regime bets that died in the 2025-2026 holdout.
Intraday signals (H1, H4, H9) have gross edges of 1-12 bps, at or below realistic round-trip costs.
Calendar effects (H8) are real but too small to pay for weekly turnover and did not survive the holdout.
The 36-symbol universe is survivorship-biased: every coin still listed in 2026 is in the sample, which flatters long-loser and short-alt books.
conclusion.data_access_finding: Binance's public API is reachable and serves ~21 days of open-interest history (no API key needed). OI cannot be backtested over the cached 2020-2026 window; it has to be recorded forward. The one-month flow_bars dataset is unusable (trade_count is always zero and buy/sell volume does not reconcile).
next_data_needed: Start a forward recorder for open interest, funding, and 1m bars now (public endpoints, no keys), then re-test H9 in 3-6 months.
Order-book / L2 snapshots or true taker-flow bars (the existing flow_bars are broken).
Spot and multi-exchange perp prices (basis, funding dispersion, cross-exchange lead-lag).
Delisted-symbol history (to remove survivorship bias from cross-sectional tests).
